heroSection.title: Front-End Web Developer
heroSection.phrase: Beyond distributed architecture and latency optimization, I understand engineering as a discipline of continuous craftsmanship, systematic curiosity, and radical attention to detail.
heroSection.subtitle: I firmly believe that high-impact software doesn't emerge solely from efficient algorithms, but from a deep empathy for the end user, transparent collaboration, and an relentless pursuit of technical simplicity. Every line of code is a commitment to long-term stability.

aboutMe.intro: I’m 25 and based in Valinhos, São Paulo, Brazil. I bring more than 4 years of professional experience building and delivering digital products.
aboutMe.description: I specialize in turning complex ideas into efficient, scalable, people-centered web experiences. I combine a strong technical foundation in interface development with an end-to-end perspective on how software is planned, built, and validated.
aboutMe.approach: To me, web development is more than writing code: it is where design, architecture, and strategy meet. My goal is to build dependable solutions that deliver real value to businesses and the people who use them.
aboutMe.locationNote: Open to collaborating on new challenges, teams, and innovative projects.

areas.frontendDescription: I build modern, functional, and optimized web applications, with a focus on usability, performance, and thoughtful details.
areas.projectDescription: I coordinate digital projects and teams to meet deadlines, align technical work with business goals, and keep communication clear.
areas.qaDescription: I plan testing and validation processes to catch issues early and deliver robust, reliable products that are ready for their users.

aboutMe.ctaDescription: I’m always open to connecting and exploring new challenges.
